Reason for Mistake: The Planner incorrectly reclassified the promo year to 2000 by introducing an arbitrary “majority-of-exposure normalization,” despite multiple sources clearly indicating the promo occurred in November 1999 (e.g., “Oh My God” sent to radio as a promo in Nov 1999; End of Days soundtrack/film released in 1999).
